title: Ellenial · Free tools for everyday life
meta_description: Tools that make life easier. Free and private. No ads, no trackers, no paywalls.
hero_eyebrow: A small tool that goes a long way. Completely free.
hero_title: Tools that make life easier. Free and private.

hero_costs: See what it costs to run

why_p1: I got tired of using apps that promise to never share or sell my data, but then have micro-transactions for basic features, unreasonably high costs, or can only be used with a subscription. I've literally spent hours unchecking hundreds of trackers and cookies just to use a “free” app.
why_p2: Technology is growing fast, and AI is here to stay, so I started exploring the possibilities myself. Setting hard lines was the easiest part: no AI-generated art, no paywalls, as little stored private data as possible (lower costs and lower risks) and, if it's ever needed, always encrypted. Then a question came up: is this even possible?
why_p3: I started building an app for myself to understand the limits and the possibilities, and guess what, I was surprised! I realised I could make something out of this and make my days easier! That's where the idea was born to go public, not to make money, but to give something back. It's a small niche, but hopefully it can add something to your everyday life too.
